conditions.name: Nephrolithiasis (Kidney Calculi)
conditions.description: Calculus formation within the renal pelvis or calyces causing severe colicky flank pain radiating to groin with micro- or gross hematuria.

conditions.name: Acute Pyelonephritis
conditions.description: Upper urinary tract bacterial infection characterized by costovertebral angle tenderness, high fever, rigors, and lower urinary symptoms.

conditions.name: Acute Uncomplicated Cystitis
conditions.description: Infection of lower urinary tract causing dysuria, frequency, urgency, and suprapubic discomfort without systemic symptoms.

conditions.name: Acute Kidney Injury (AKI)
conditions.description: Abrupt decrease in renal filtration causing fluid retention, elevated creatinine, and electrolyte imbalances.

conditions.name: Nephrotic Syndrome
conditions.description: Glomerular disorder marked by severe proteinuria >3.5g/day, hypoalbuminemia, and generalized peripheral edema.

conditions.name: Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH)
conditions.description: Adenomatous enlargement of prostate periurethral zone causing lower urinary tract obstructive and irritative symptoms.

conditions.name: Renal Cell Carcinoma
conditions.description: Malignant neoplasm of renal cortex typically presenting with classic triad of flank pain, hematuria, and palpable abdominal mass.

conditions.name: Acute Glomerulonephritis
conditions.description: Immune-mediated inflammation of glomeruli resulting in hematuria (tea-colored urine), hypertension, and periorbital/peripheral edema.

conditions.name: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE)
conditions.description: Multisystem autoimmune connective tissue disease characterized by malar rash, inflammatory polyarthritis, and antinuclear autoantibodies.

conditions.name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
conditions.description: Chronic inflammatory polyarthritis causing symmetric synovial proliferation, prolonged morning stiffness (>1 hour), and progressive joint erosions.

conditions.name: Ankylosing Spondylitis
conditions.description: Seronegative spondyloarthropathy characterized by axial spine inflammation, sacroiliitis, morning stiffness improving with exercise, and anterior uveitis.

conditions.name: Systemic Sclerosis (Scleroderma)
conditions.description: Autoimmune disease characterized by widespread dermal and visceral fibrosis, microvascular obliteration, and Raynaud's phenomenon.

conditions.name: Sjögren Syndrome
conditions.description: Chronic autoimmune disorder affecting exocrine glands causing keratoconjunctivitis sicca, xerostomia, and bilateral parotid enlargement.

conditions.name: Acute Gout
conditions.description: Intensely painful crystal-induced inflammatory arthritis caused by monosodium urate precipitation, most commonly in the first metatarsophalangeal joint (podagra).

conditions.name: Acute Appendicitis
conditions.description: Luminal obstruction of the vermiform appendix leading to ischemia, inflammation, right lower quadrant tenderness (McBurney's sign), and rebound tenderness.

conditions.name: Acute Cholecystitis
conditions.description: Acute gallbladder inflammation typically caused by cystic duct gallstone obstruction, producing right upper quadrant pain radiating to right scapula (Murphy's sign).

conditions.name: Acute Pancreatitis
conditions.description: Inflammatory destruction of pancreatic parenchyma characterized by constant epigastric pain radiating to the back and markedly elevated amylase/lipase.

conditions.name: Acute Ascending Cholangitis
conditions.description: Bacterial infection superimposed on biliary tree obstruction presenting with Charcot's triad (fever, jaundice, RUQ pain) and Reynolds' pentad.

conditions.name: Decompensated Cirrhosis with Ascites
conditions.description: End-stage liver fibrosis leading to portal hypertension, fluid accumulation in the peritoneal cavity, coagulopathy, and hepatic encephalopathy.

conditions.name: Acute Upper Gastrointestinal Bleed
conditions.description: Hemorrhage proximal to the ligament of Treitz originating from peptic ulcers or varices, manifesting with coffee-ground vomiting and dark tarry stools.

conditions.name: Peptic Ulcer Disease
conditions.description: Mucosal defect in stomach or duodenum caused by H. pylori or NSAIDs, presenting with epigastric burning relieved or worsened by food.

conditions.name: Celiac Disease
conditions.description: Immune-mediated enteropathy triggered by dietary gluten ingestion leading to villous atrophy, malabsorption, and nutrient deficiencies.

conditions.name: Acute Myocardial Infarction (STEMI / NSTEMI)
conditions.description: Acute myocardial necrosis caused by thrombotic coronary artery occlusion, characterized by retrosternal pressure radiating to left arm/jaw.

conditions.name: Congestive Heart Failure (Decompensated)
conditions.description: Impaired cardiac output and elevated filling pressures causing pulmonary venous congestion, orthopnea, and severe peripheral pitting edema.

conditions.name: Acute Pulmonary Embolism
conditions.description: Embolic occlusion of pulmonary arterial tree (usually from deep vein thrombosis) causing acute V/Q mismatch, hypoxia, and right heart strain.

conditions.name: Infective Endocarditis
conditions.description: Microbial colonization of cardiac valvular endothelium producing vegetations, persistent bacteremia, and systemic embolic phenomena.

conditions.name: Atrial Fibrillation with Rapid Ventricular Response
conditions.description: Supraventricular tachyarrhythmia characterized by disorganized atrial electrical activation, irregular ventricular response, and loss of atrial kick.

conditions.name: Acute Pericarditis
conditions.description: Inflammation of pericardial sac causing sharp retrosternal chest pain relieved by leaning forward and worsened by recumbency, accompanied by friction rub.

conditions.name: Acute Severe Asthma Exacerbation
conditions.description: Acute bronchospasm and airway hyperresponsiveness causing expiratory wheezing, hyperinflation, and ventilation-perfusion mismatch.

conditions.name: Pneumonia
conditions.description: Acute pulmonary parenchymal infection leading to alveolar consolidation with productive purulent cough, fever, and hypoxemia.

conditions.name: Acute COPD Exacerbation
conditions.description: Acute worsening of baseline respiratory symptoms in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease requiring escalation in bronchodilator and corticosteroid therapy.

conditions.name: Spontaneous Pneumothorax
conditions.description: Collection of free air in pleural space causing ipsilateral lung collapse, sudden unilateral pleuritic pain, and diminished breath sounds.

conditions.name: Active Pulmonary Tuberculosis
conditions.description: Mycobacterium tuberculosis cavitary pulmonary infection presenting with chronic productive cough, hemoptysis, drenching night sweats, and constitutional wasting.

conditions.name: Acute Ischemic Stroke
conditions.description: Sudden onset focal neurological deficit resulting from acute cerebral arterial occlusion, requiring urgent thrombolysis or endovascular thrombectomy.

conditions.name: Acute Bacterial Meningitis
conditions.description: Life-threatening leptomeningeal inflammation presenting with classic triad of nuchal rigidity, high fever, and altered mental status.

conditions.name: Migraine
conditions.description: Primary headache disorder characterized by recurrent attacks of pulsating unilateral headache preceded by reversible focal neurological visual aura.

conditions.name: Parkinson's Disease
conditions.description: Neurodegenerative hypokinetic movement disorder caused by nigrostriatal dopaminergic depletion presenting with resting pill-rolling tremor and cogwheel rigidity.

conditions.name: Generalized Tonic-Clonic Seizure
conditions.description: Bilateral synchronous paroxysmal electrical discharge resulting in abrupt loss of consciousness, tonic extension followed by clonic jerking, and postictal confusion.

conditions.name: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)
conditions.description: Inner ear disorder caused by canalithiasis within the semicircular canals, resulting in brief episodic spinning sensations triggered by changes in head position.

conditions.name: Influenza
conditions.description: Acute orthomyxovirus respiratory infection characterized by sudden onset high fever, prominent diffuse myalgias, and dry hacking cough.

conditions.name: Infectious Mononucleosis (EBV)
conditions.description: Epstein-Barr virus infection classically manifesting with triad of exudative tonsillopharyngitis, posterior cervical lymphadenopathy, and profound fatigue.

conditions.name: Malaria
conditions.description: Parasitic protozoan infection transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes causing paroxysmal cyclical rigors, high fever, severe intravascular hemolysis, and jaundice.

conditions.name: Severe Sepsis / Septic Shock
conditions.description: Dysregulated host response to infection resulting in life-threatening multiorgan dysfunction, profound circulatory hypotension, and cellular metabolic abnormalities.

conditions.name: Acute Urticaria (Hives)
conditions.description: Mast cell-mediated erythematous, intensely pruritic, transient edematous plaques (wheals) with central pallor resolving within 24 hours.

conditions.name: Atopic Dermatitis (Eczema)
conditions.description: Chronic relapsing pruritic inflammatory skin disease characterized by epidermal barrier dysfunction, xerosis, and lichenification in flexural folds.

conditions.name: Plaque Psoriasis
conditions.description: Chronic immune-mediated hyperproliferative skin disease presenting with well-demarcated erythematous plaques covered by silvery-white micaceous scales.

conditions.name: Herpes Zoster (Shingles)
conditions.description: Reactivation of latent varicella-zoster virus within dorsal root ganglia producing painful, unilateral grouped vesicles in a strict dermatomal distribution.

conditions.name: Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (New Onset)
conditions.description: Autoimmune beta-cell destruction resulting in absolute insulin deficiency, marked osmotic diuresis, compensatory polydipsia, and catabolic weight loss.

conditions.name: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
conditions.description: Progressive insulin secretory defect on background of peripheral insulin resistance presenting with insidious osmotic symptoms and metabolic dysfunction.

conditions.name: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA)
conditions.description: Acute metabolic decompensation from profound insulin deficiency with ketoacidosis, Kussmaul respirations, fruity breath, and severe dehydration.

conditions.name: Graves' Disease (Hyperthyroidism)
conditions.description: Autoimmune stimulation of TSH receptor by autoantibodies causing thyroid gland hyperplasia, thyrotoxicosis, exophthalmos, and pretibial myxedema.

conditions.name: Hashimoto's Thyroiditis (Hypothyroidism)
conditions.description: Autoimmune lymphocytic infiltration and destruction of the thyroid gland resulting in primary hypothyroid metabolic slowing.

conditions.name: Primary Adrenal Insufficiency (Addison's Disease)
conditions.description: Autoimmune or infectious destruction of adrenal cortex causing glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid deficiencies, postural hypotension, and cutaneous hyperpigmentation.

conditions.name: Iron Deficiency Anemia

conditions.name: Immune Thrombocytopenic Purpura (ITP)
conditions.description: Autoantibody-mediated peripheral platelet destruction causing isolated thrombocytopenia and mucosal / mucocutaneous bleeding.

conditions.name: Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML)
